howto.what: Claude 会引导你安装 1Password CLI、启用桌面应用集成、登录账户，并通过 op 命令在 tmux 会话中安全地读取或注入密钥，避免直接暴露。
howto.when: 当你需要安装 1Password CLI、启用桌面应用集成、登录（单个或多个账户），或通过 op 读取/注入/运行密钥时。

say.text: 帮我安装 1Password CLI 并登录
say.note: Claude 会创建 tmux 会话并引导完成登录。

say.text: 从 1Password 读取我的 GitHub 令牌
用 1Password 运行一条需要密钥的命令
say.note: Claude 会用 op run 注入密钥执行。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through installing the 1Password CLI, enabling desktop app integration, signing in, and securely reading/injecting secrets via op commands inside a tmux session without leaking secrets.
howto.when_en: When you need to install the 1Password CLI, enable desktop app integration, sign in (single or multi-account), or read/inject/run secrets via op.

say_en.text: Help me install 1Password CLI and sign in
say_en.note: Claude creates a tmux session and walks you through sign-in.
Claude uses op inject to retrieve it securely, not showing the raw value.

say_en.text: Run a command that needs a secret from 1Password
say_en.note: Claude uses op run to inject the secret before execution.
